executiveSummary: Terra LUNA experienced a catastrophic de-pegging event and total ecosystem collapse, with the LUNA price crashing from $85 to a final value of $2.46, representing a 97.1% loss. A terminal death spiral was triggered at tick 3, characterized by massive sell-side pressure from WHALE and PANIC agents that overwhelmed the algorithmic peg mechanism. Despite late-stage liquidity injections from SYBIL and WHALE_01, the Gini coefficient of 0.959 indicates extreme wealth concentration and a total loss of protocol decentralization.

failureModes.name: Algorithmic Death Spiral
failureModes.description: The mint/burn mechanism failed to absorb sell pressure as LUNA price dropped, leading to hyper-inflationary signaling. Massive sells by WHALE_03 and PANIC_02 at t=3 broke the peg's confidence early.

failureModes.name: Mass Staking Exodus
failureModes.description: The lack of a lock-up period (lock=0t) allowed yield farmers and whales to instantly unstake and dump tokens at the first sign of volatility. This removed the primary supply sink, accelerating the price floor collapse.

failureModes.name: Sybil-Driven Exit Liquidity Extraction
failureModes.description: Large-scale Sybil clusters executed massive sell orders during brief price recoveries, preventing any sustained rebound. SYBIL_02 alone dumped over 74 billion units at t=101, crushing recovery efforts.

attackVectors.label: Coordinated Whale Dump
timeline: WHALE_03 and WHALE_09 initiate massive sells of ~25M LUNA each at t=1.
PANIC_02 and PANIC_03 follow with immediate unstaking and market sells at t=3.
WHALE_02 and WHALE_07 unstake over 25M tokens combined at t=10 to exit remaining positions.
LUNA price collapses from $85 to $0.0122 by t=4.

attackVectors.label: MEV and Arbitrage Exploitation
timeline: MEV_02 and MEV_04 front-run the peg instability with 95M+ sell orders at t=20.
ARB_03 and ARB_05 attempt to capture spread but ultimately contribute to sell-side volume at t=41.
MEV_03 executes a massive 7.3B token dump at t=60, finalizing the initial wipeout.

recommendations.rationale: The 0-tick lock allowed for an instantaneous bank run; a delay would have throttled the initial death spiral.
The initial $3B reserve was insufficient to defend the peg against the $100M initial liquidity and high-velocity whale exits.
The 19.45% APY attracted mercenary capital (FARMER agents) who had no loyalty to the protocol during the de-peg.

comparison.reasoning: The simulation perfectly mirrored the real-world collapse, including the rapid de-pegging, hyper-inflation of the native token, and the failure of the reserve to halt the death spiral.
